name: tum apne shikwe ki baaten na khod khod ke puchho

content.roman:
aaj ik aur baras biit gayā us ke baġhair
jis ke hote hue hote the zamāne mere
tum apne shikve kī bāteñ na khod khod ke pūchho
hazar karo mire dil se ki is meñ aag dabī hai
dilā ye dard-o-alam bhī to muġhtanim hai ki āḳhir
na girya-e-saharī hai na āh-e-nīm-shabī hai
nazar ba-naqs-e-gadāyāñ kamāl-e-be-adabī hai
ki ḳhār-e-ḳhushk ko bhī dāvā-e-chaman-nasabī hai
huā visāl se shauq-e-dil-e-harīs ziyāda
lab-e-qadah pe kaf-e-bāda josh-e-tishna-labī hai
ḳhushā vo dil ki sarāpā tilism-e-be-ḳhabarī ho
junūn o yaas o alam rizq-e-mudda.ā-talabī hai
chaman meñ kis ke ye barham hui hai bazm-e-tamāshā
ki barg barg-e-saman shīsha reza-e-halabī hai
imām-e-zāhir-o-bātin amīr-e-sūrat-o-ma.anī
'alī' valī asadullāh jānashīn-e-nabī hai
tum apne shikwe ki baaten na khod khod ke puchho
hazar karo mere dil se ki is mein aag dabi hai
dila ye dard-o-alam bhi to mughtanim hai ki aaKHir
na girya-e-sahari hai na aah-e-nim-shabi hai
nazar ba-naqs-e-gadayan kamal-e-be-adabi hai
ki KHar-e-KHushk ko bhi dawa-e-chaman-nasabi hai
hua visal se shauq-e-dil-e-haris ziyaada
lab-e-qadah pe kaf-e-baada josh-e-tishna-labi hai
KHusha wo dil ki sarapa tilism-e-be-KHabari ho
junun o yas o alam rizq-e-muddaa-talabi hai
chaman mein kis ke ye barham hui hai bazm-e-tamasha
ki barg barg-e-saman shisha reza-e-halabi hai
imam-e-zahir-o-baatin amir-e-surat-o-mani
'ali' wali asadullah jaanashin-e-nabi hai
